name: HOOK 3
speech: Steam cleaning your mattress kills dust mites. That's exactly why it doesn't help.
Listen, killing dust mites was never the same thing as removing them.
You spray, they die, and every one of them is still in the mattress, still in the pillow,
still in the fabric your face is on all night, and your body was never reacting to a living
mite. It reacts to a protein. It's in their droppings, and it's in the mites themselves.
A dead one carries just as much of it as a live one, so the spray does exactly what it promised,
and the thing setting you off never leaves the bed. Each mite drops about 20 pellets a day into
the fabric, so everyone the spray misses keeps adding to the pile, and everyone it kills stays
down there as a body you're still breathing off all night. That's why you keep washing,
and it keeps coming back. You're cleaning the surface. The load is underneath it. There's only
one thing that lowers that load, taking them out of the bed, and you can only take them out while
they're still alive. That's the whole thing. A plant-derived pheromone lure draws mites up
out of the fabric they're hiding in. In lab testing, they came from over 50 centimeters away,
so they cross the mattress to reach it. Then, an adhesive surface holds everyone that arrives,
and they leave the room on the card instead of staying in the bed. Up to 99% of them captured
in lab testing. A dead mite can't walk to a card, which is why the bottle in your cupboard
was never going to end this. It takes away the only way they were ever going to leave.
Lure and trap isn't new. It's how pest control has caught things for decades. Somebody took the
method the whole category runs on, and aimed it at the one place nobody ever had. The inside
of a mattress. No insecticide. Nothing sprayed on the thing you sleep on. It's called capture
cards. Slide one under the mattress and forget about it. Put one under the pillow. If that's where
you wake up blocked. Works on memory foam, spring, latex, pillow tops, and the mattress
protector you already have on. On week 12, lift it out and hold it up to your phone light.
Everything on that card spent three months not being in your bed. One card runs three months.
